entries.volumeNotes: Strong consistent volume all day, slowly dropping volume throughout the day but more than normal for EOD

entries.volumeNotes: Volume was strong on the open, then dried up later in the session, made a new HOD a few times but on lower volume each time, which is signs of exhaustion

entries.volumeNotes: Volume was increasing as it made new highs, usually not signs of exhaustion but heavier selling came in for the big flush from 4 to 3.20, should have been covering there instead of adding, while looking to re-enter higher if the opportunity presented itself
